title: Data Analyst
description: Role: Data Analyst General Location: France (Hybrid) Type: Contract Position Please find below Job Description: Role: Data Analyst General JD- The ideal candidate should have a strong grasp of business operations, encompassing strategic planning, process improvement, and data-driven decision-making. They must be able to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that accelerate organizational growth. We are looking for at least 6 years of experience in the data area. Advanced Power BI Proficiency: Mastery of Power BI is a core requirement. The consultant should demonstrate expertise in leveraging Power BI’s capabilities to design dynamic reports, interactive dashboards, and advanced data visualizations. Their skills should include data modeling, query optimization, and the seamless integration of diverse data sources. Machine Learning Knowledge: Understanding machine learning techniques and their practical application is highly desirable. Strong SQL Knowledge. Mandatory skill – Basic Knowledge of Databricks: Familiarity with Databricks is desirable, including a foundational understanding of its collaborative environment for data engineering, machine learning, and analytics. Excel (VBA) programming
